'''Zone 12''' was a private heavily fortified shipyards located in the [[Blastfield Shipyards]] of the [[Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] an [[Escape pod/Legends|Escape pod]] from Imperial [[Harrower-class dreadnought]] [[Javelin (Harrower-class)|''Javelin'']] containing a member of [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor's]] crew landed in Zone 12, which was then overrun by Imperials. Using information provided by Captain [[Drizan]] and his [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] ally [[Quil]], Barsen'thor stormed Zone 12 and rescued his companion.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zone 12 appears as an area on Corellia in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
